annotations.exact_quote: Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) approximates a non-negative data matrix with the product of two low-rank non-negative matrices by minimizing the cost of such approximation.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要以NMF为核心并提出RSS-NMF，用非负矩阵因子分解近似数据矩阵，符合非负矩阵分解定义。

annotations.exact_quote: the product of two low-rank non-negative matrices
annotations.reason_zh: 明确用两个低秩非负矩阵的乘积近似数据矩阵，属于显式低秩分解/低秩表示。

annotations.exact_quote: Robust Semi-Supervised Non-Negative Matrix Factorization With Structured Normalization
annotations.reason_zh: 标题直接标明半监督设定；摘要中RSS-NMF利用给定有标注样本的标签指示进行结构化归一化，属于有限监督与未标注样本结合的学习。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a robust semi-supervised NMF model (RSS-NMF)
annotations.reason_zh: 提出半监督NMF，利用有限的已标注样本监督进行聚类，有限标注构成实质不完整监督条件，遗漏弱监督设定。
